title: Wedelolactone Ameliorates Ischemic Stroke by Inhibiting Oxidative Damage and Ferroptosis via HIF-1alpha/SLC7A11/GPX4 Signaling.
authors: Tao, Xingru; Zhao, Meina; Gao, Kai; Zhang, Wei; Xu, Dong; Li, Wangting; Mu, Fei; Lin, Rui; Guo, Chao; Li, Ruili; Wang, Jingwen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Wedelolactone通过HIF-1alpha/SLC7A11/GPX4通路抑制缺血性脑卒中中的氧化损伤和铁死亡，仅用分子对接评估小分子与HIF-1alpha结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Wedelolactone (Wel), a furocoumarin compound extracted from the medicinal plant Eclipta prostrata L. has been shown to exhibit significant neuroprotective effects. However, the potential of Wel to improve ischemic stroke (IS) and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: The middle cerebral artery occlusion and reperfusion (MCAO/R) and oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R) were established to evaluate the potential neuroprotective of Wel. Neurological function, brain infarct volume, brain swelling, and histopathological staining were analyzed to demonstrate the therapeutic efficacy of Wel. The occurrence of ferroptosis was confirmed by quantifying the levels of ROS and Fe(2+), and by examining the ultrastructural features of cells. The binding affinity between Wel and HIF-1alpha was evaluated using Molecular docking. Immunofluorescence and Western blot analyses were conducted to explore the regulation of Wel on the HIF-1alpha/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway. Finally, the expression of HIF-1alpha was down-regulated to verify whether Wel exerts neuroprotection by modulating HIF-1alpha to inhibit ferroptosis of cells. RESULTS: The results demonstrated that Wel effectively inhibit neuron ferroptosis after MCAO/R in a dose-time-dependent manner, thereby alleviating brain injury. Moreover, at the cellular level, Wel significantly reduced the accumulation of Fe(2+) and ROS after OGD/R. Further investigation revealed that Wel might inhibit neuronal ferroptosis and improve IS by promoting the nuclear translocation and accumulation of HIF-1alpha, subsequently regulating the expression of downstream proteins SLC7A11 and GPX4. Notably, the inhibitory effect of Wel on ferroptosis was markedly attenuated by HIF- 1alpha siRNA in OGD/R PC12 cells. CONCLUSION: Our discovery revealed that the Wel could alleviate IS by inhibiting oxidative damage and ferroptosis via HIF-1alpha/ SLC7A11/GPX4 signaling pathway. Wel may represent a promising active compound for anti-IS, while also providing novel insights into the elucidation of its molecular mechanisms and potential clinical implications.
abstract_zh: 目的：蟛蜞菊内酯（Wel），一种从药用植物旱莲草（Eclipta prostrata L.）中提取的呋喃香豆素类化合物，已被证明具有显著的神经保护作用。然而，Wel改善缺血性脑卒中（IS）的潜力及其潜在机制仍不清楚。方法：建立大脑中动脉闭塞再灌注（MCAO/R）和氧糖剥夺/再复氧（OGD/R）模型，以评估Wel的潜在神经保护作用。通过分析神经功能、脑梗死体积、脑肿胀及组织病理学染色，验证Wel的治疗效果。通过量化ROS和Fe(2+)水平，并检查细胞超微结构特征，确认铁死亡（ferroptosis）的发生。利用分子对接（molecular docking）评估Wel与HIF-1alpha之间的结合亲和力。采用免疫荧光和Western blot分析，探讨Wel对HIF-1alpha/SLC7A11/GPX4通路的调控作用。最后，下调HIF-1alpha的表达，以验证Wel是否通过调节HIF-1alpha抑制细胞铁死亡来发挥神经保护作用。结果：结果表明，Wel以剂量-时间依赖方式有效抑制MCAO/R后神经元铁死亡，从而减轻脑损伤。此外，在细胞水平上，Wel显著降低了OGD/R后Fe(2+)和ROS的积累。进一步研究发现，Wel可能通过促进HIF-1alpha的核转位和积累，进而调节下游蛋白SLC7A11和GPX4的表达，从而抑制神经元铁死亡并改善IS。值得注意的是，在OGD/R PC12细胞中，HIF-1alpha siRNA显著减弱了Wel对铁死亡的抑制作用。结论：我们的发现揭示，Wel通过HIF-1alpha/SLC7A11/GPX4信号通路抑制氧化损伤和铁死亡，从而缓解IS。Wel可能代表一种有前景的抗IS活性化合物，同时为其分子机制和潜在临床意义的阐明提供新的见解。
